causal_conclusion.primary_program_blocker: The immutable runtime evidence checkout has no complete, predeclared asset-closure contract. Route, profile, navmesh, and now DBC dependencies were discovered serially after downstream work began.
causal_conclusion.why_this_is_a_loop: Each retry proved only the next missing member of an implicit runtime asset set. The workflow validated individual assets instead of validating the complete transitive runtime asset closure before build/seal/live admission.
